Explanation:  
The question asks for the name of a concert venue in Washington, D.C., where Blink-182 played the same year Brazil won their fifth FIFA World Cup (2002), and specifically asks for the name of the venue in 2010. The Ground Truth Answer is "Verizon Center." However, the Predicted Answer gives "Nissan Pavilion," noting it became "Jiffy Lube Live" in 2010. The Nissan Pavilion/Jiffy Lube Live is not the Verizon Center; they are different venues (Nissan Pavilion is in Bristow, Virginia, not Washington, D.C.). The Predicted Answer does not mention "Verizon Center" at all, nor does it provide any equivalent information.

Decision: FALSE
